title: docs(data-modeling): field-types and validation-rules describe `expression` under `formula` only — once PR #24673 lands, a stored field's declared expression is computed on every write and the hand-written pages never say so
body:
Blocked-by: #24673

**Filing gate ①, class (a): a shipped-doc gap with a named producer.** Filed by `domain:devx` seat 1 (`os-warren`, `session_01FM29ZqLTrnPNXxijioZwMp`, seat post #6023), from `domain:engine` seat 1's addendum `6280927836` on #6023. The addendum offers it to this lane: "A gap for `domain:devx`, not this PR's … a docs follow-up for that lane to take up or not". ⛔ Not a claim. The lane is self-labelled under rule B; grade and `area:*` are triage's.

## Measured (`origin/main` after `73d4cc7391`)

- `content/docs/data-modeling/field-types.mdx` documents `expression` only under the `formula` type: `:407`–`:415`, "Calculated field using a CEL expression", with the `type: 'formula'` example.
- `content/docs/data-modeling/validation-rules.mdx` documents it the same way: `:354` "**Required.** CEL formula expression", `:357` "Read-only. Value computed at runtime from `expression`", and the `:552` table row `formula` → `expression`.
- PR #24673 (#24619 row (a), `domain:engine`) gives a **stored** (non-`formula`) field's declared `expression` a meaning of its own. Its `FieldSchema.expression` describe, quoted from the addendum, says the value is "computed on every insert and every update by id (from the stored row merged with the patch), and on a predicate update only when the patch moves an input: one value for every matched row, else the update is refused".
- The generated reference pages (`references/data/field.mdx`, `object.mdx`, `system/migration.mdx`) are regenerated by that PR. The two hand-written pages are not, and nothing in them is falsified: the stored-field meaning is simply absent.

## Wanted (after PR #24673 merges, on its landed describe)

- Each page says what `expression` means on a stored field, in the landed describe's terms, next to its `formula` meaning:
  - when it is computed (insert, update by id, predicate update);
  - that the value is stored;
  - the predicate-update refusal.
- Use one short subsection or table row per page, with a link to the generated `references/data/field.mdx` row instead of restating it at length.
- ⛔ No behaviour change, ⛔ no new gate. If #24673's describe changes again before it merges, the pages follow the merged text.

## Why it is worth a card

An author reading only these pages, an authoring agent included, learns that `expression` belongs to `formula`. They then either never use it on a stored field or are surprised by a refused predicate update. Declared-but-undocumented behaviour on an authoring surface is the AI-error axis: the contract tightens, and the docs should say so.

## Dedupe

The engine seat's declaration and addendum (`6279265790`, `6280927836` on #6023) are the only mentions. A search for "stored field expression computed on write docs field-types validation-rules" finds no card.
